form.title: Product card
form.sellerHint: One per line, as name: value

sellerErrors.summary: Fix these seller attribute lines before submitting the card.
sellerErrors.missingSeparator: Add a colon between the name and value.
sellerErrors.missingName: Enter an attribute name before the colon.
sellerErrors.missingValue: Enter a value after the colon.

result.title: Extracted attributes

empty.title: No card yet
empty.description: Pick a sample or paste a card on the left, then run the extraction.

result.missingNone: Every required attribute has a value
result.missingUnconfirmed: Some extracted attributes have no confirmed value
result.requiredUnknown: Required attributes have not been defined
result.categoryUnknown: Category not detected. Select it manually and retry.
result.fallbackDescription: The model response is unavailable. Local rules extracted these values. Review the result and add missing attributes manually.

review.title: Current card corrections
review.description: Confirm, edit or reject a value in the table. The decision is saved for this card without extracting it again.
review.currentCount: Awaiting review in this card: {{count, number}}
review.savedWithoutCard: Decision saved. To rerun this older entry, enter its original card again.
review.quoteHint: Copy the supporting text from the card. This value will be saved as a manual decision.
review.quoteInvalid: The quote must match a non-empty passage in the card exactly.

progress.extracting: Selecting a category and filling attributes

risk.title: Support score

reasons.field_unconfirmed: The link between the value and the field needs review
reasons.range_lost: Quote contains a range or limit
reasons.model_inference: Check the link to the quote
reasons.indirect_value: Value does not directly match the quote

risk.description: Support score: a heuristic measure of support in the text, not a probability of correctness.

rejections.title: Omitted after checking the quote
rejections.invalidEvidence: The quote was not found in the card.
rejections.otherProduct: The property refers to packaging or another product.
rejections.otherField: The quote describes a different attribute.
rejections.fieldUnconfirmed: The quote does not establish this attribute.
rejections.negation: The value does not match the negation in the text.
rejections.unitMismatch: The units do not match the attribute.
rejections.numberUnconfirmed: The number, sign or unit does not match the text.
rejections.rangeMismatch: The bounds or type of range do not match.
rejections.rangeLost: The text gives a range or limit, rather than an exact number.
rejections.valueUnconfirmed: The quote does not support the value.
rejections.fieldTypeMismatch: The value does not match the attribute type.
rejections.conditionalSupport: Support depends on a condition. An unconditional value was omitted.

workspace.interruptedDescription: The request is saved. Retry it explicitly or return to the previous result.
workspace.checking: Saved result. Checking decisions with the server.
workspace.unchecked: Saved result. Decisions could not be checked with the server.

history.title: Extraction history
history.description: Saved cards and requests in progress.

landing.title: Turn descriptions into product cards
landing.description: Paste the seller’s text. Admit finds attributes and links each value to its source, ready for your review.
